name: create-f7t-app
description: FunnySoft generator for Next.js, Laravel + Inertia, and Laravel API + Next.js

scripts.build: bun build cli/src/index.ts --outfile create-f7t-app.js --target node --format esm && chmod +x create-f7t-app.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build && bun run verify:release
scripts.check: oxlint cli && oxfmt --check cli package.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts && tsc --noEmit && vitest run
